title: Establish Prospect Cohort Signal Archive for Latency & Cost Sensitivity
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Objective: build a reusable archival dataset and lightweight query surface that captures per-prospect-cohort signals for latency tolerance, per-token cost sensitivity, and model feature dependencies. The archive will be the canonical input to competitive analyses, procurement readiness checks, and regional fallback playbooks. Scope: (1) define cohort taxonomy (buyer personas, verticals, scale buckets), (2) collect signals from telemetry, sales intel, and market research (latency SLO sensitivity, cost buckets, feature criticality), (3) standardize schema and retention rules, (4) expose a simple dashboard and CSV/BigQuery export for PM/Eng/Revenue partners. This ticket coordinates PM-led curation, one engineering task to add telemetry hooks, and one design task for dashboard wireframes. Success means the archive supports three hypothesis queries (see acceptance criteria) and feeds the procurement trigger engine in a follow-up ticket.
acceptance_criteria: Cohort taxonomy documented and approved by Sales and Solutions (doc link in comments)
Telemetry events and fields required for the archive are defined and an ENG ticket created for instrumenting missing fields (ENG dependency listed)
Initial dataset (6-week rolling) ingested into a queryable store and accessible to PM/Revenue via dashboard and export
Three seed analyses completed: a latency-sensitivity scatter by vertical, a per-token cost-elasticity table, and a model-feature dependency matrix
Hand-off doc and runbook for updating cohorts created and stored in Confluence
deliverables: Telemetry spec and ENG ticket for instrumentation
Seed dataset (6-week rolling) in internal analytics workspace
risks: Telemetry gaps: some latency signals not currently emitted from Dedicated/Private deployments
Small sample sizes for niche verticals leading to noisy signals
Alignment risk between Sales persona labels and PM taxonomy requiring reconciliation
